Simulation gives TC = 417 ppm/C and line regulation = 0.31 V/V. Both come from too little PMOS headroom and Vds mismatch, so I'm changing the topology.

- **Headroom:** n1 = Veb + Vgs1 ≈ 1.5 V, which leaves M3 only 0.3 V. At -40 C or at low VDD, M3 goes into triode.
- **Mismatch:** n1 is fixed while d2 tracks VDD. The M3:M4 current ratio therefore moves with VDD.

Changes in the new program:
- **Swap the sense side.** M2 becomes the diode, on the R1 side. M1 drives a high-impedance node n1.
- **Inverting loop amplifier.** M7, a common-source NMOS sitting on its own BJT Q4, drives pg through a PMOS diode M6. This keeps the loop negative-feedback.
- **Fixed drain voltages.** n1 and d2 are both held near Veb + Vgs, so they no longer depend on VDD. All PMOS Vds values then change equally with VDD.
- **More headroom.** The NMOS bodies are tied to their sources (deep n-well), BJT areas are larger, and the PMOS runs at higher gm/Id with longer L.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Headroom: n1≈1.5V leaves M3 0.3V, so triode at -40C/low VDD. Line: d2 tracks VDD, n1 fixed, so M3/M4 ratio moves. Fix: sense node with inverting CS M7 on own BJT and PMOS diode; d2/n1 both fixed. Body-tied NMOS, larger BJTs, higher gm/Id, longer L PMOS."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (3e-6, 1.5e-6, 8e-6),    # PTAT branch current
    "k_r2":   (9.3, 7.5, 12.0),        # R2/R1
    "gmid_n": (22, 14, 26),            # NMOS pair + CS amp (weak inversion, low Vgs)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (14, 9, 18),             # PMOS mirror (low Vdsat for headroom)
    "Lp":     (4.0, 2.0, 8.0),         # long L -> low gds, good line reg
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    mQ = 2                       # unit BJT multiplicity (larger area -> lower Veb, more headroom)
    I = p["I"]
    dvbe = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dvbe / I
    R2 = p["k_r2"] * R1

    def veb(i, m):
        return 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 * m / i)

    ve1 = veb(I, mQ)
    # NMOS with body tied to source (deep n-well) -> no body effect, lower Vgs
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=0.0)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.3)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # Left (sense) branch: M3 -> M1 (gate = d2) -> Q1 ; n1 is high-impedance node
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "d2", "e1", "e1", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mQ)
    # Right (diode) branch: M4 -> M2 (diode) -> R1 -> Q2 (N*mQ)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "d2", "a", "a", mn)
    n.R("R1", "a", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N * mQ)
    # Inverting loop amp: CS NMOS M7 on own BJT Q4 -> n1 sits at Veb+Vgs, matching d2
    n.dev("M7", "pg", "n1", "e4", "e4", mn)
    n.Q("Q4", "vss", "vss", "e4", m=mQ)
    n.dev("M6", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)      # PMOS diode sets mirror gate
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    n.C("Cn1", "n1", "vss", 0.5e-12)
    # Output branch: M5 -> R2 -> Q3
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=mQ)
    # Start-up: when vref low, sx high -> MS pulls pg low -> currents flow; off once vref ~1.2V
    n.M("MSP", "sx", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    vref = ve1 + p["k_r2"] * dvbe
    itot = 4 * I + 0.6e-6
    # n1, d2, vref all fixed vs VDD -> PMOS Vds change equally; residual via gds mismatch
    line = 0.5 * (mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12)) * 0.2 + 1e-3
    return n, {
        "vref": vref,
        "tc_ppm": 15.0,
        "power": itot * VDD,
        "line_reg": line,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
